# Generation Log — Micro-Pilot (2026-11-13, Flow project "Micro-Pilot — Movie Proof Test")
Verified against the account's Google One credit history. Start 400 cr → End 120 cr. SPENT: 280 cr. Blocked: 0. Refunded: 0. Redos used: 0.
Note: the ledger reconciles exactly 400 − 280 = 120; the 50 daily credits did NOT appear as extra spendable balance on top of the 400.
| # | Scene | Model | Ref? | Credits | Usable | Verdict |
|---|-------|-------|------|---------|--------|---------|
| 0 | TEST-HERO portrait | Image (Nano Banana 2.1) | — | 0 | — | Locked test portrait |
| 1 | Dialogue, rainy street | Veo 3.1 Fast | portrait | 400→380 (20) | 7.9s | EXCELLENT — face/hair/stubble/jacket match; line verbatim; lip sync good |
| 2 | Car interior angle | Veo 3.1 Fast | portrait | 380→360 (20) | 7.9s | VERY GOOD — same face in profile; NOTE: Veo invented an extra radio-reply line not in the script |
| 3 | Same dialogue scene | Veo 3.1 Quality | NONE (text only) | 360→260 (100) | 7.9s | WEAKEST — different man (slicked wet hair, tactical vest), action wrong (runs at camera), word error "them" for "him" |
| 4 | Rooftop fight | Veo 3.1 Fast | portrait | 260→240 (20) | 7.9s | EXCELLENT — same face; 1 attacker, no weapons/blood; choreography slightly staged/slow |
| 5 | Car chase | Veo 3.1 Fast | — | 240→220 (20) | 7.9s | GOOD — same direction, no collision; rear tracking rather than side |
| 6 | Car chase (same prompt word-for-word) | Veo 3.1 Quality | — | 220→120 (100) | 7.9s | BEST CHASE — true side tracking, richer detail |
| 7 | 1080p upscale of #6 | Flow upscale | — | 120→120 (0) | 7.9s | FREE confirmed — no transaction |
CONCLUSIONS: (1) Portrait reference on Fast holds the character — the workflow is proven. (2) Quality without references drifts — do not use Quality for faces. (3) Quality wins for no-face action detail. (4) Native audio can invent unscripted lines — dialogue scenes need line checks. (5) Cost per usable second on Pro Fast ≈ 2.5 cr/s.
